title: Leray rectangle bound for abelian etale sheaf cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $F$ an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of $X$. Use higher direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] and cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Let $c,e$ be natural numbers. Suppose $R^qf_*F=0$ for every $q>e$, and $H^p(Y,R^qf_*F)=0$ for every $p>c$ and every $q\geq0$. Then $H^n(X,F)=0$ for every $n>c+e$.

proof.text: Use the already proved source theorem Etale.subsingleton_H_of_rightDerived_lowerStar. It identifies Ext cohomology with ordinary derived sections, applies Functor.isZero_rightDerived_comp_of_lt_add to direct image and sections, and transports along lowerStarCompSheafSectionsTerminalIso. The acyclic-composable-pair hypothesis follows from the exact left adjoint of direct image. The generic rectangle-vanishing theorem uses the Mathlib Grothendieck spectral object: above total degree c+e, every E2 term is zero, hence the abutment is zero. No project Cartan-Eilenberg presentation or project convergence structure is needed.

theorem subsingleton_H_of_rightDerived_lowerStar {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) {c e : ℕ}

      IsZero ((((f)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).rightDerived q).obj F))

      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H ((((f)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).rightDerived q).obj F) p))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : c + e < n) : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H F n)
